# Revenue-Growth.ai

> Revenue-Growth.ai is a fractional AI GTM engineer: a six-month AI GTM / RevOps embed. Data cleanup first, then process, then agents. Your stack first. The platform is included when it fits.

Revenue-Growth.ai embeds in the client’s own stack — Salesforce or HubSpot — with data cleanup, then process, then agents that research and draft. People still approve the send. They keep the handoff. The platform is included when it fits; it is not the lead offer.

## Primary deep read

- [Fractional AI GTM engineer: 6-month embed](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/fractional-ai-gtm-embed/): Who a fractional AI GTM / RevOps embed is for, and what six months of data cleanup, process, then agents buys. Platform included when it fits.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/): Six-month AI GTM / RevOps embed. data → processes → agents. Your stack first.
- [Platform](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/platform): Included when it fits. Multi-agent control plane in the customer’s cloud — not the product being bought.
- [Platform architecture](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/platform/architecture): Trust-boundary overview of where the included platform runs. Secondary reading.
- [How we run](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/how-we-run): How Revenue-Growth.ai runs internally. Not the offer.
- [Insights](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/): Notes on the six-month AI GTM / RevOps embed — cleanup, process, then agents. Platform included when it fits.
- [GTM engineer vs agency vs full-time hire: who ships what](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/gtm-engineer-vs-agency-vs-full-time/): What ships first, who owns it after, where agents run, and who sends — full-time hire, agency, DIY build, or an embed.
- [Cuban Is Right About Custom. Wrong About Who Does It for RevOps.](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/cuban-custom-revops-embed/): Mark Cuban is right that utilization wins; for RevOps the fix isn’t another GTM wrapper. It’s an embed that cleans data, fixes process, then puts agents in your stack.
- [Per-task automation billing doesn’t scale](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/per-task-automation-billing/): Why Make, Zapier, and n8n Cloud bills track CRM event volume — and why the path out is a six-month embed (data → processes → agents), with capacity-based runtime included when it fits.
- [Grok Bot for business, OpenClaw for enterprise, and Hermes for business](https://www.revenue-growth.ai/insights/grok-bot-for-business/): Personal teammate agents vs coverage of the book via a six-month embed — data → processes → agents.

## Proof

- AskNicely — lifted forecasted win rate 18% and doubled qualified pipeline in the same quarter.
